findings.text: "Current state" still says the coordinator handles publication of the accepted descendants. The new bullet at line 37 says the repair completion is merged and the gate is terminal, so the summary is stale. Fix: update the summary to say the stacked repair is accepted and merged, with only the final combined checks recorded at `e87c904f`.

Lines 12-13 and 21 say the full reference build and the final combined checks "remain pending". Lines 26-36 show that they passed. Fix: mark these bullets as superseded by the later bullet, or reword them to past tense with the date.
"Gate 61952 is terminal" does not say what the gate is or what state it ended in. Fix: name the gate (for example the CI or merge gate) and its result.
